exposure: prematurity (low gestational age and birth weight)
outcome: "refer" result on the newborn hearing screening (NHS) test
cohort: This study included 267 singleton neonates who were born alive at 32 weeks gestational age or less.
finding: The presence of funisitis was significantly and independently associated with an increased risk of abnormal newborn hearing screening results, while the administration of antenatal corticosteroids was related to a normal NHS result.
birth_weight: N/A (described as 'low birth weight' for prematurity definition, but no specific range given)
